from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CaseEvidence(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document used to match against result options."""
    document_title: Optional[str] = Field(description="Title or identifier of the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    case_nature: Optional[str] = Field(description="Type of case (e.g., '二审民事判决', '执行异议审查')")
    primary_party_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the appellant or objectioner")
    primary_party_role: Optional[str] = Field(description="Role of the primary party (e.g., '上诉人', '异议人')")
    ruling_outcome: Optional[str] = Field(description="The core ruling text (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判')")
    court_fee_amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Amount of the court fee if specified")
    court_fee_payer: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who bears the fee as named in the text")
    fee_text_quote: Optional[str] = Field(description="Verbatim text of the fee bearing section")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[CaseEvidence]
